classification.difficultyReason: Read shaded intervals and combine empirical-rule percentages using symmetry and complements.

content.prompt: What proportion of scores is shaded in each diagram?

spec.description: Normal curve with right-arrow horizontal axis, dashed boundaries at 0 and 1, and the region between them shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading and boundary labels are permanent givens; the supplied percentage is answer-only.

answer.worked:
By symmetry, half of the central $68\%$ lies between $0$ and $1$.
$$\begin{align*}P(0<z<1)&\approx\frac{68\%}{2}\\&=34\%\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Normal curve with dashed boundaries at −1 and 1 and central shading.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading and boundary labels are permanent givens; the supplied percentage is answer-only.

answer.worked:
The empirical rule gives approximately $68\%$ of scores within one standard deviation of the mean.
$$P(-1<z<1)\approx68\%.$$

spec.description: Normal curve with dashed boundaries at −2 and 0, shaded between them.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading and boundary labels are permanent givens; the supplied percentage is answer-only.

answer.worked:
By symmetry, half of the central $95\%$ lies between $-2$ and $0$.
$$\begin{align*}P(-2<z<0)&\approx\frac{95\%}{2}\\&=47.5\%\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Normal curve shaded between −3 and 3, with the extreme tails unshaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading and boundary labels are permanent givens; the supplied percentage is answer-only.

answer.worked:
The empirical rule gives approximately $99.7\%$ of scores within three standard deviations of the mean.
$$P(-3<z<3)\approx99.7\%.$$

spec.description: Normal curve shaded between −1 and 3, with a dashed boundary at −1.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading and boundary labels are permanent givens; the supplied percentage is answer-only.

answer.worked:
Use symmetry for the regions from $-1$ to $0$ and from $0$ to $3$.
$$\begin{align*}P(-1<z<3)&\approx\frac{68\%}{2}+\frac{99.7\%}{2}\\&=34\%+49.85\%\\&=83.85\%\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Normal curve with a dashed boundary at 1 and the right tail shaded.
spec.mathematics: Shaded interval z > 1; plotting ends only truncate the displayed curve.
spec.answerVisibility: Shading and boundary label are permanent givens; the supplied percentage is answer-only.

answer.worked:
The two tails outside $-1$ and $1$ share the remaining percentage equally.
$$\begin{align*}P(z>1)&\approx\frac{100\%-68\%}{2}\\&=16\%\end{align*}$$
